topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: The world feels a bit smaller now. I kept my scrolling fingers busy with digital friendships, finding comfort in distant connections. We chatted, shared our dreams, and laughed at the same absurdities, and I thought that was enough. Then, unexpectedly, it turns out, your city and mine share the same skyline. It’s strange how the internet can make the miles melt away, yet the physical space between us still echoes. Maybe this new twist is just the universe’s way of playing matchmaker, or maybe it’s simply a coincidence. Either way, the thought of bumping into you here, in this web of streets and stories, brings a bittersweet twist to my daily walks.
